description: Search 1 to 10 videos (or a playlist, capped at 10) for a question and get only the relevant excerpts: ranked by BM25, each with the surrounding context, [m:ss] and a timestamp link, under a token cap. Use it instead of reading whole transcripts (about 12k tokens per hour of speech). Put exact phrases in double quotes to boost them. Lexical: if nothing matches, it lists words the videos do use so you can retry with a synonym.

contextSec.description: Seconds of context before and after each match. Default 20

maxTokens.description: Cap on the whole result. Default 2000

query.description: Words to look for; "quoted phrases" are boosted

urls.description: Video URLs, or one playlist URL

name: research_videos
title: Research videos
